anomalies.observed: The USB-C D- pins (J3 A7/B7) and U25 pin 4 (I/O2, the second I/O2 pin of the USBLC6-2P6) all sit on the same large net as the ground pins of many parts (J3 A1/B1/A12/B12, U25 pin 2, U26 pin 2, C1 pin 2, Module1 GND pins, etc.). That net is named USBC_D_N. Meanwhile U25 pin 3 (the other I/O2 pin) and U24 pin 6 are on the separate net USBCP_D_N.
anomalies.expected: USB-C D- should connect to the USB D- data net (with U25 pins 3 and 4 both on the I/O2 line). It must not be tied to ground.
anomalies.impact: USB-C D- is shorted to ground. USB 2.0 data on the USB-C port cannot communicate and the ESD clamp's data line is pulled to ground, so USB-C data (and the USB-C path through U24/U25) would fail.

anomalies.observed: D30 is a dual LED with anode A2 (pin 4) on ESTOP_OUT. Its K2 cathode (pin 2) goes through R60 whose second end is also on ESTOP_OUT. The companion channel R59 returns its resistor to GND (net 203). The K2 branch therefore forms a loop from ESTOP_OUT back to ESTOP_OUT and carries no current.
anomalies.expected: The ESTOP_OUT indicator channel should be anode on ESTOP_OUT, cathode through R60 to GND, mirroring R59 on the K1 channel.
anomalies.impact: The ESTOP_OUT indicator LED never lights, so the e-stop status indication is lost. The rest of the e-stop chain is unaffected.

anomalies.observed: R36 is valued "24k" in the schematic and SPICE deck. Its library description and MPN (FRC0805J240TSD) describe a 24 Ω part.
anomalies.expected: The value should match the part description and MPN (24 Ω), or the description and MPN should be corrected to match a 24 kΩ value.

evidence.quote: (comp (ref "R36") (value "24k") ... (description " 125mW Thick Film Resistors 150V ±100ppm/℃ ±5% 24Ω 0805 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS")

anomalies.impact: If the part is actually 24 Ω across VOUTP/VOUTN, it would load the output heavily. If it is actually 24 kΩ, the description is wrong. Either way, the bleed or divider behaviour is uncertain.

parsed.summary: The most likely deviation is the USB-C D- net (J3 A7/B7 and U25 pin 4) being merged with the ground net, which would short the USB data line to ground. Secondary findings are a shorted LED loop on D30/R60 and a value/description mismatch on R36.
